A pink skinned [[Pachydermoid]] pirate who was part of the crew of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Pachydermoid pirate appeared only in the book [[The Pirates of Tarnoonga: A Droid Adventure]] and was not present in the [[Pirates of Tarnoonga]] television episode.
